description: Wind routing table. One meta-router endpoint dispatches to seven data domains. The interactive channel is the MCP meta-router; the batch channel is the per-domain CLI. Both spend the same daily quota.

interactive.use: conversational lookups — agent calls market_search_tools to locate the right Wind tool, then market_call_tool to run it

batch.use: scheduled jobs and scripts that cannot reach MCP tools

stock_data.covers: stock screening, quotes, K-line, intraday quotes, company profile, financials, shareholders, events, technicals, risk

fund_data.covers: fund / ETF / LOF screening, quotes, K-line, intraday quotes, profile, financials, holdings, performance, holders, company

index_data.covers: index and sector quotes, K-line, intraday quotes, profile, fundamentals, technicals

bond_data.covers: bond profile, issuer, market valuation, issuer financials

financial_docs.covers: announcements, annual and quarterly reports, prospectuses, financial news

analytics_data.covers: cross-instrument aggregation, weighted averages, rankings, derived composite metrics

arbitration: Announcements, annual/quarterly reports, prospectuses, regulatory disclosure -> financial_docs.get_company_announcements
Macro, industry or FX EDB indicators (even without the word macro) -> economic_data.search_economic_indicator to confirm the code, economic_data.query_economic_indicator_data for the numeric series
Screening request without a named instrument -> the matching domain's search_* tool
Last price, change, volume, K-line, intraday line, range performance -> the matching domain's quote / K-line tool; historical ranges always go through K-line
Financials, share capital, shareholders, events, technicals, risk, holdings, performance -> the matching domain's natural-language tool
guardrails: Do not answer a financial fact with web search, a public web page, or model memory. Wind data only.

analytics_data is not the entry point for complex questions and not a bulk-quote entry point. Quotes, K-line and price metrics always go to the dedicated tool; split a large instrument list into several calls.

Units and magnitude come from the response metadata (data.unit, column unit, meta.unit / meta.magnitude). Never convert a value yourself; if the metadata gives no unit, keep the raw value and say the unit is unknown.
When the instrument cannot be resolved, ask for the full name or the Wind code. Never guess a code or append an exchange suffix.
Never fall back to analytics_data to paper over an authentication, quota, network or routing failure.
discipline: One dataset, one pull per day: check the daily receipt before pulling; reuse the cached result instead of calling again.
Interactive lookups go through the meta-router MCP; the per-domain CLI is for scripts and scheduled jobs only.
The MCP channel and the CLI share one API key and one daily quota. They are not two allowances.
